An archer got lost in the {wiki:Thais Troll Cave|Thais Troll Cave}, east of Thais, and died of poison. Go down three floors, cross the poison fields around the {creature:Slime|Slimes} spawn and use his body to receive a {item:Bow}, 5 {item:Poison Arrow|Poison Arrows}, a {item:Mana Potion} and a {item:Health Potion}.
An archer got lost and died of poisoning.
Troll cave entrance east of Thais
or {item:Antidote Rune}, or {item:Destroy Field Rune} for the Poison Fields (recommended)
Healing runes (Intense or Ultimate Healing), if needed, because of the Slimes
Bring something for poison: you will have to cross {item:Poison Field|Poison Fields} on both sides of the Slime spawn.

Leave Thais by the **east** gate and go to the {wiki:Thais Troll Cave}. The entrance is a hole on the **north** side of a small mountain ({coord:32491,32260,7}). Use the {item:Shovel} to open the hole and go down.

Inside you can go left (Trolls) or right (Orcs); the two sides join on the third floor. There is also a back entrance halfway up the mountain, but that one leads to the {wiki:Silver Amulet Quest}, not the main cave.
Once inside the cave, head **east** and go down a hole.
First floor: the path to the hole
Follow the path **east** and go down the hole. On this floor you find {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors}, {creature:Orc|Orcs} and, sometimes, {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions} pulled by other players.
Second floor: the path to the next hole
Follow the path **south**. On both sides of the {creature:Slime|Slimes} spawn you have to cross {item:Poison Field|Poison Fields}.
Last floor: the path to the dead archer
The Poison Fields poison you. Use an {item:Antidote}, an {item:Antidote Rune} or destroy the fields with {item:Destroy Field Rune}.
Use the corpse at the **north** end of the room to receive the reward.
Bow, 5 Poison Arrows, Mana Potion and Health Potion

Go back the same way: return **north** through the {item:Poison Field|Poison Fields} and, at each of the holes you came down, use the {item:Rope} on the rope spot to go up a floor. After the last hole you come out on the surface next to the mountain east of Thais ({coord:32491,32260,7}); head **west** to the city.
Without a {item:Rope} you can't climb out through the holes: don't lose it.
